alt: A three-tiered custom cake with a sculpted poodle figurine topper featuring textured white fur, golden-tan accents on legs and face, and a pink bow on its ear, the top two tiers wrapped in vibrant watercolor-style fondant with soft washes of coral, peach, lavender, mint, and sky blue, adorned with cascading sugar flowers.

A two-tiered African savanna-themed cake with a sculpted lion figurine atop a gray fondant rock, vibrant sunset backdrops in orange and yellow with acacia tree silhouettes, Kente-inspired geometric patterns in red, blue, yellow, and black, black fondant elephant and giraffe silhouettes against the glowing sky, and dark fondant bushes flanking both tiers.

A dinosaur-themed cake featuring a multi-tiered prehistoric island with vibrant green foliage, palm trees, and rocky terrain, topped by two hand-sculpted fondant dinosaurs — a bright yellow one in the foreground and a green-and-orange one behind — with expressive eyes and playful expressions.

A cupcake cake designed as an oversized blue cupcake liner with white frosting, decorated with pastel-colored spherical candies, topped by a meticulously sculpted teddy bear in tan fondant with a light-blue bow tie holding a cluster of glossy balloon-like spheres.

A sculpted cake of a woolly mammoth captured mid-stride with trunk raised and curled, curved ivory tusks contrasting with rich textured brown fur showing fine striations mimicking real hair, glossy black eye with white highlight on a diorama base designed as snowy icy landscape with white snow drifts, gray rocks dusted with faux snow, and winding blue frozen river.

A whimsical cake slice designed as a monstrous pepperoni pizza with a sculpted green monster face made from fondant, featuring bulging white eyes with black pupils, thick green eyebrows, a wide screaming grin revealing sharp white fangs, a long textured red tongue, and the pepperoni slices strategically placed around the face.

A two-tiered white cake with a sculpted teddy bear topper wearing a delicate white ribbon, the bear having soft brown fur texture and expressive black eyes, the cake decorated with subtle heart patterns embossed into the fondant and vibrant red heart decorations scattered around the base.

caption: Woodland Fairy Cake
alt: A whimsical cake designed as a magical forest scene centered around a mushroom house with an orange cap, wooden door and window, nestled among lush green moss-like frosting, vibrant red-and-white spotted mushrooms, sugar flowers in peach, coral, and cream, a fairy figure with golden wings, and a rustic wooden sign bearing the name "LIZZIE."

A sculpted cake of a woolly mammoth captured mid-stride with trunk raised and curled, rich textured brown fur, curved ivory tusks, dark painted eyes, set on a snowy icy landscape base with white snowdrifts, gray rocks, and a vivid blue stream or frozen river.

A woodland-themed cake set featuring a two-tiered cake with a moose figurine topper on a red and black buffalo plaid upper tier, birch bark-textured lower tier, accompanied by two smaller cakes each adorned with a lamb and goat figurine in grassy settings.

A three-tiered cake with soft pink fondant base featuring white lace-like patterns and a shimmering green ribbon cascade intertwined with lifelike green leaves and pinecone decorations, middle tier adorned with miniature fondant baby shoes with pink bows, top tier with another set of baby shoes and an elaborate white sugarwork crown topper.

A ladybug cake topper featuring a vibrant red ladybug with matte black spots, deep black head with a large cartoonish eye in blue and white, yellow-tipped antennae, perched atop a glossy bright green surface resembling a leaf.

A sculpted cake diorama featuring two anthropomorphic reindeer on a bright green sled — the larger reindeer mid-action with one leg kicked up, wide green eyes, prominent black nose, red scarf flowing behind, and the smaller reindeer looking up in delight, both wearing red scarves with small branching antlers.

A theatrical jack-in-the-box cake featuring a jester character in a red hat with blue and green horns emerging from a purple and green box adorned with theater masks, musical notes, and abstract patterns, surrounded by fondant props including a feathered mask, books topped with a quirky hand wearing glasses, a scroll, and beads, on a red fondant stage curtain base with a "Class of 2018" plaque.

A sculpted cake designed as a seated brown teddy bear with textured icing fur, glossy black eyes, and a blue ribbon bow tie, holding a small round cake decorated in blue and yellow with heart motifs, a fondant baby bottle, pacifier, and a personalized plaque reading "Sylas Logan," surrounded by five teddy bear and onesie-shaped cookies.

A piñata donkey cake adorned with colorful paper strips in shades of blue, yellow, pink, orange, and green, featuring a large expressive eye and detailed snout, sitting on a circular base covered in crushed graham crackers mimicking sand, surrounded by a geometric-patterned border and a small fondant cactus with a pink flower.

A fishing-themed birthday cake with the name "JOE" spelled out in large sculpted fondant letters each uniquely decorated — the "J" as a red-and-white buoy, the "O" with colorful fish and a "GONE FISHING" sign, the "E" in green with a fishing rod and lily pads — all emerging from a blue and white frosted ocean wave base.

A Harry Potter-themed cake featuring a sculpted white owl resembling Hedwig perched atop a monstrous animated book with a gaping mouth, wooden wand, sharp bone-like teeth, and a long pink tongue, set against a deep blue background.

A three-dimensional cake sculpted as Dumbo the elephant in textured blue fondant with soulful blue eyes, a tiny Timothy Q. Mouse figurine wearing a party hat on his head, a striped party hat with the number "4" suggesting a fourth birthday, scattered confetti and ribbon curls, a stained-glass-style circus tent decoration, and a horn-shaped party favor.

A sculpted cake of a cartoonish green dragon with textured fondant skin, orange segmented belly, purple accents on feet and forehead, large expressive blue eyes, and a playful tongue, holding a small blue bubble wand with translucent bubble-like spheres scattered around, perched on a dark chalkboard-style base.

A whimsical cake designed as a slice of layered dessert in cartoonish comic-book style, with alternating horizontal layers of pale yellow sponge and soft pink frosting outlined in bold black lines, topped with white whipped cream, a glossy red cherry, and a pink heart-shaped topper.

A sculpted cake figurine of a squirrel seated upright on a textured organic base resembling a weathered rock, with finely detailed chestnut brown fur, creamy white underbelly, glossy black eyes, holding a small bright yellow flower with an orange center.

caption: Sugar Patchwork Teddy Bear!!
alt: A colorful patchwork teddy bear with mismatched fabric patterns, large black eyes, and a red bow tie holds a white stick in its mouth while waving against a black background.
A painted figurine of a smiling sloth hanging upside down from a brown tree branch with green leaves, set on a mossy green base against a light blue background.

caption: Team Umizoomi Cake
alt: A detailed fondant cake topper features Teletubbies characters, a small wooden bridge, and a large floral number 3, all set on a green landscape with a blue stream spelling out the name "AUDREY" on lily pads.

caption: Teddy Bear Cake
alt: A two-tiered pink and purple birthday cake topped with a white teddy bear wearing a blue bow tie and a number one candle.
A whimsical sculpture of an anthropomorphic hamburger with googly eyes and a tongue sticking out, holding a french fry and a pickle while sitting atop a pile of fries.

caption: Muddy Piggy Cake
alt: A pink pig-shaped birthday cake sits in a green mud puddle decorated with chocolate icing and a "Happy Birthday" banner.

caption: Leapfrog Cake
alt: A two-tiered lime green birthday cake decorated with a large orange number one candle and a frog mascot wearing a red cap, accompanied by colorful fondant letters spelling "RILEY" on a grassy base.

caption: Kitty at the Beach with Sand Castle Cake
alt: A detailed cake designed to look like a sandy beach scene features a sandcastle with three flags, a realistic cat figurine, a colorful beach ball, a towel, and flip-flops.

caption: Ghostbusters Cake
alt: A two-tiered black birthday cake decorated with fondant figures of Slimer and the Stay Puft Marshmallow Man, topped with the Ghostbusters logo, and featuring the name "Connor" and "Happy Birthday" amidst green slime.

caption: Toy Cake
alt: A whimsical, multi-tiered cake features a blue and yellow striped base, a white tier with red polka dots, a large brown teddy bear wearing a blue bow tie, a yellow giraffe resting on the bear's head, and a stack of colorful toy blocks balancing on top.
A detailed miniature figurine of a purple dragon with metallic silver wings perched atop a rocky base surrounded by green vines.

caption: Ladybug Cake
alt: A red ladybug-shaped birthday cake with black spots and large cartoon eyes sits on a bed of green fondant leaves, featuring a leaf to the left inscribed with "HAPPY BIRTHDAY EMMA" in blue and red icing.

caption: Storybook Cake
alt: A whimsical cake shaped like an open book features fondant figures of Dr. Seuss characters, including the Cat in the Hat, Thing 1, a tiger, a rabbit, and a red dog, set against a black background.

caption: Monkey and Turtle Baby Shower Cake
alt: An elaborate sculpted cake features a baby monkey wearing a chef's hat and bib riding on the back of a green turtle, also wearing a chef's hat, with the names "KAYLIEGH AND JASON" written in yellow letters on the base.

caption: Yo Gabba Gabba Cake
alt: A colorful birthday cake features fondant characters from the children's show "In the Night Garden," including Igglepiggle, Upsy Daisy, Makka Pakka, and Wotting, along with a large number "2" and the name "AUDEN" in pink letters on top.
A whimsical farm-themed cake features a pink barn with a red dome roof perched atop a green, rolling hill base, surrounded by fondant cows, pigs, ducks, and a rooster.
A close-up of a whimsical, hand-carved wooden giraffe sculpture featuring bright blue eyes, a wide toothy grin, and brown spots painted on its orange body.

caption: DRAGON BALL Z CAKE
alt: A Dragon Ball Z themed birthday cake features a sculpted figure of Super Saiyan Goku standing atop a rocky base, surrounded by edible signs reading "8," "Dragon Ball Z," and "Camron Happy Birthday."

caption: Space Cake
alt: A space-themed birthday cake features a blue, star-speckled base adorned with colorful planets and three green, multi-eyed aliens, topped by a yellow and red rocket ship with "Happy Birthday" written on it.

caption: Baby's First Birthday Cake!
alt: A two-tiered birthday cake decorated with pink and yellow plaid fondant, white polka dots, and pink flowers, featuring the name "KARAN" in blue letters on the bottom tier and a large pink number "1" topper on the upper tier.
A sculpted cake diorama featuring the character Bendy from the game Bendy and the Ink Machine standing amidst a dilapidated, wooden room with broken planks and exposed brick walls.
A Super Mario-themed cake features a silver statue of Mario emerging from a green pipe, set atop a tiered base decorated with brown and green fondant to resemble dirt and grass.
A sculpted panda cake with textured black and white frosting, blue eyes, and white claws sits on a green base next to a decorative bamboo frame featuring red blossoms.
